method: MEASURED. Ableton RPC and local costs measured directly on 2026-09-17 against the live session. Per-operation wall clock and per-phase capture timings read from durable evidence written by real runs: artifact created_at/completed_at and logs/capture_journal/*.jsonl state transitions. Astra from 85 recorded reasoning audits. Nothing here is an estimate of untimed code.

astra_single_call.note: Local prompt build + grounding validation is 0.0027% of this. No local win exists.

PRODUCER_ANALYZE_traced.project: Groove Rider working copy, 32 tracks, 126 BPM
PRODUCER_ANALYZE_traced.note: See producer_analyze_batching_v1.json for the full comparison.

per_capture_pass_measured.note: Three consecutive passes from the same run. Phase boundaries are durable journal records.
per_capture_pass_measured.unattributed_note: 16.6s inside the RECORDING phase is NOT yet attributed. Candidates: arm/disarm RPCs (~12 calls = 4.4s at the measured 0.368s/RPC), the transport-start poll, the end-of-region padding, and wait_until_wav_shared_readable whose budget is 12.0s. That function returns waited_s (live_capture.py:442) but every caller discards it, so the split cannot be recovered from evidence. Running one pass under copilot.perf resolves this. If WAV handle release really is consuming most of a 12s budget, capture is running at its timeout boundary and is one slow disk away from CAPTURE_FINALIZATION_TIMEOUT.

unattributed_resolved.hypothesis_that_was_WRONG: The audit suspected wait_until_wav_shared_readable was consuming much of its 12.0 s budget. It is not. Measured waited_s across 6 passes: 0.00024 - 0.00038 s. WAV handle release is effectively instantaneous and the capture is nowhere near its finalization timeout.
unattributed_resolved.how: capture_parallel_pass already decomposed its own phases (prepare_breakdown, stop_breakdown incl. staging_handle_release.waited_s, record_s, region_s, pre_roll_qn). Every caller discarded timings. The fix was to propagate them into the capture result and the FINALIZING journal record, not to add new instrumentation.

intrinsic_vs_implementation.headline: For the one fully measured multi-source run: 34.5s of the 165.0s was the audio it was there to observe. 130.5s (79%) was implementation. Overhead is 3.8x intrinsic, and ~27.5s of overhead is paid PER SOURCE.
intrinsic_vs_implementation.biggest_single_lever: Capture N sources in ONE playback pass. capture_parallel_pass already accepts a recorders list and arms several taps per pass; the caller invokes it once per source. Collapsing 3 passes to 1 removes 2x(11.5s intrinsic + 27.5s overhead + 6.2s restore) = ~90s from a 165s run.
intrinsic_vs_implementation.second_lever: Attribute and then shrink the 16.6s unattributed RECORDING overhead. Requires one traced run; do not guess at it.

budget_classification.INTRINSIC_AUDIO_DURATION: region length x number of playback passes. 11.5s per pass here.
budget_classification.MODEL_BOUND: p50 50.3s, p95 112.1s. Provider-dependent; set no target.
budget_classification.IMPLEMENTATION_OVERHEAD: ~27.5s per capture pass + ~6.2s per inter-pass restore + ~35s run head/tail.
